gaps: no candidate was on the ballot: the tabulation prints only blank ballots
City, town and school elections held on the same day

The Secretary of State does not tabulate municipal elections (councils, school boards, local questions); each city or town clerk posts its own results, and they are not loaded. Most Maine towns elect at their annual town meetings.
